name: Plank

phases.name: brace
phases.cue: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs

phases.name: breathe
phases.cue: Breathe steadily, straight line heels to head

formTips: Rest on your forearms with your elbows right under your shoulders
Tuck your toes and lift your body into one straight line from heels to head
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs as if about to be poked in the stomach
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold
